description: A previous run of trellis-cb51 'hung' in bun test src/analysis/ with zero output for 30 minutes. Root cause: node_modules was unbuilt, so bun stalled resolving missing zod/typescript packages offline without surfacing an error; the salvaged registry.ts was also corrupted (stray '* ' prefixes inside requireAcyclic). Fix: run bun install before any bun test, verify salvage files compile, and always wrap test commands in timeout.
resolution: bun install restored packages; corrupted lines fixed; all tests and check:all gates pass in bounded time
